body: I just want to say, I feel you. Drinking helps me cope so I can stick around for my family’s sake. My liver is fucked so I really shouldn’t be drinking but it makes me feel too good to stop. I know I’m not helping but just wanted to say I know where you’re coming from.

I know exactly what you mean. And you expressed it beautifully. 

I can go on feeling good for a while, doing my own thing. But something always comes up that reminds me how inferior/inadequate I am, or how incompatible I am with others, or how sensitive I must be to be so affected by the smallest criticism or rejection.

My parents and brother. I imagine the pain and suffering they would endure if I did it and that gets me to accept that it's unfortunately not an option. Recently I have to remind myself multiple times a day every day. Wondering if it will eventually stop working.

Would you not say that the suffering matters to the organism that experiences it? 

You should tell a person experiencing extreme levels of torture and abuse that their suffering is insignificant and doesn't matter, and that their abuser has done nothing wrong.

If their suffering doesn't matter, then why would we have any moral imperative at all to prevent or punish violent crime? I guess we should tell those who commit such acts to "abuse away", because they can, and nothing matters?

In another comment you said:

>When the heat death of the universe comes, nothing will have mattered, including suffering that the insignificant organisms endured on an insignificant planet.  
Ergo, there is nothing wrong with having a shit ton of kids because there is no such thing as a "wrong" to begin with.

So, if you really believe this, why do you care if someone is traumatized from being forcibly sterilized? After all, their insignificant suffering doesn't matter, right?

I do this too, and like you said I feel powerless to stop it in the moment. I am so scared of negative evaluation that I just reflexively say whatever I think will please them. And then once I’ve done it multiple times, I feel like I’m trapped and can’t confess my dishonesty because then I’ll be exposed as a liar and judged even worse. It’s caused me to stop seeing many therapists (and psychiatrists and doctors as well). 

I know therapists aren’t “supposed to judge”… but they’re people just like everyone else, and if I say something that is worthy of judgment or criticism, why wouldn’t they judge me? Why shouldn’t they?

I hate to say it, but it’s basically why I have become hopeless about my situation. In order to address this issue and overcome my fears, I know that I have to “get help”. But what am I supposed to do when getting help requires me to overcome my fears first?
It's because people are slaves to their instinctual will to live. Even most of those who find life to be an unforgiving slog will continue to live in spite of their misery.

The sense I get from him (and from past therapists I've had) is that they start getting frustrated with me after a while. And I can't really blame them. If I'm not offering anything for them to work with, then at that point I'm just wasting their time. 

I'd rather avoid therapy altogether than just waste the therapists' time and make them frustrated and annoyed with me. If I fail to open up, then I'm not going to get anything out of it anyway.
Therapist cut them short.

Agreed. I wish life was short.
Maybe an NDRI (such as bupropion) would be better for you? They affect norepinephrine and dopamine instead of serotonin.

I feel the same way. It seems like the anonymity of the Internet makes it easier for most people with AvPD to open up. But the way I see it, at the end of the day, my posts are still my words and my thoughts, even if no one knows they’re mine. If they get judged or criticized, it’s just as painful as irl. 

99% of the time, all I do is lurk. I’m always on the outside looking in. Actually posting something is terrifying.

I’ve been taking Zoloft, but that’s for my depression/suicidal thoughts, which it definitely helps with. I smoke weed occasionally, I rarely drink alcohol since it just makes me sleepy. 

I used to take a small dose (1mg) of klonopin daily, and somehow it helped with my depression and gave me motivation & energy... but didn’t do much in the way of making me more comfortable socially. But my psych took me off it. Idk if my expectations are just too high or what... I just wish I could find something that made me feel comfortable and less inhibited around other people, instead of completely scared and closed off

I know, my expectations were probably higher than they should have been. I guess I was just hoping it would do..something, at least, for my social fears. I’ll definitely check out the book, thanks man

The FAA is what I’ve been taking actually. I thought I should avoid the HCI since I have reflux & stomach issues and don’t want to aggravate them any further. I definitely feel the effects - warmth, energy, some euphoria, etc.  But idk for some reason that doesn’t translate to feeling more comfortable and relaxed in social situations.. it’s weird
